title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E06 — The Verdict Is In: Nano or T-Rex
In Montana, Clayton Phipps prepares to learn if his carnivore skeleton belongs to a Tyrannosaurus rex or the controversial Nanotyrannus; in Wyoming, Mike Harris and Aaron Bolan race against the impending winter digging at a promising new site.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E03 — Curse of the Carnivore
Clayton Phipps and his team prepare to flip a 20,000-pound carnivore fossil out of the earth and onto a flatbed to get it to the lab for analysis; Mike Harris hunts for a duckbill skull; Jared Hudson uncovers an ancient reptile.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E07 — Dark Secrets of the Sphinx
New discoveries uncover the dark secrets of Egypt's strange half-man, half-lion beast, revealing why the pharaohs were so intent on transforming into this powerful and ferocious monster.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E06 — Wrath of the Minotaur
A new excavation at the mysterious home of the Minoans leads to a startling discovery about real-life origins of the Minotaur, and experts decode artifacts that point to bloody human sacrifices for the ferocious monster.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E07 — Red Storm Rising
Two astronauts trapped in the vacuum of space face a horrible death; the first close up images of Pluto show an alien landscape; residents of Houston struggle to explain videos of unidentified flying lights captured above their city at night.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E08 — Attack of the Thunderballs
Astronauts evacuate when a mystery object hurtles toward the ISS; a NASA secret agent goes undercover to retrieve missing moon rocks; scientists struggle to find answers when they discover a huge void at the edge of the solar system.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E06 — War of the Galaxies
Galaxies are locked in continual combat across the universe, and the Milky Way will face its biggest opponent ever, the Andromeda Galaxy, in a titanic and deadly struggle that could create a new and unrecognizable super galaxy.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E09 — Birth of the Monster Black Holes
New discoveries reveal an astonishing supermassive black hole that was born during the earliest days of the cosmos, and finding out how this giant grew so large so quickly may help to explain the very formation of the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E03 — Secrets of the Sun
A brand-new NASA mission to the sun reveals cutting-edge discoveries about Earth's star; as the Parker Solar Probe dives through the sun's atmosphere, its findings challenge everything known about this strange place.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E03 — Curse of Zombie Island
A village mourner at an Indonesian funeral films a dead man's hand waving through the glass window of a coffin; experts investigate and uncover powerful local priests and the practice of black magic rituals to reanimate corpses back from the dead.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E04 — Tsunami of Fire
A security camera captures panic in Lima, Peru, as a wave of fire chases terrified citizens down a city street claiming 30 lives; experts uncover reports of a disastrous fuel tanker accident with an inadequate and fatal safety response.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E05 — Train Track Terror
Security cameras capture a baby stroller pushed by a mysterious force across a London subway platform and crash onto the tracks; experts investigate and uncover a disturbing history of paranormal incidents surrounding London's subway system.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E06 — Explosion From the Underworld
Security cameras in China capture a sudden explosion beneath a city street that buries two young girls in debris; experts investigate and uncover a black market of secondhand cooking oil that may be dangerously festering in the city's sewers.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E07 — Attack of the Raging Inferno
Cameras in Kazakhstan capture a bizarre blast as train cars on a quiet railway suddenly explode in a raging inferno.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E01 — You Saw a UFO
After the death of his father, a farmer believes he witnessed a UFO; a geologist uncovers debris at the Roswell crash site; after seeing an orb in the sky, a mother suffers radiation-like burns on her body.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E02 — Alien Inside Me
Tormented by childhood memories of abduction, a woman discovers an implant in her body; a sailor captures lights over the Pacific Ocean that he believes are alien craft, and a couple finds unusual footprints in the woods.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E03 — Haunted and Hunted
A lobsterman from Maine relives a harrowing encounter that has haunted him for years; a family witnesses a strange string of lights in the sky; a man believes he can communicate with alien crafts.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E04 — Abduction in the Desert
A musician captures a strange object flying over a highway in California; a tourist takes the most compelling UFO photo ever; two friends fear they were abducted on a road trip.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E05 — Proof from Area 51
A man shares an original Area 51 video from 1992 for the first time; multiple people capture a Texas UFO sighting; a man films an unusual hovering object in Utah.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E06 — Vanished in a Portal
A man captures a beam of light in the desert; a couple is convinced they communicated with a UFO; a military man thinks he discovered a portal.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E07 — Crash in California
A Nevada man sees an object ejecting something in the sky; concertgoers believe they saw a UFO; two brothers recover material from an alleged UFO crash site in Needles, Calif.

title: Alien Encounters in Area 51: A Mysteries at the Museum Special
description: Don Wildman goes deep into the Nevada desert to see if he can uncover the truth about what's been going on at the top-secret base of Area 51.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E03 — Last Days of the Battleship
The USS Arizona and the HMS Hood were two of the most powerful warships in history, but their weaknesses paid a fatal price; experts investigate evidence that may reveal why the age of the battleship has come to a sudden and violent end.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E04 — Assassins of the Deep
The wreckages of three German U-boats are eroding at the bottom of the sea along with the stories behind their disastrous fate; now, a team of maritime archaeologists race to locate the submarines and solve the mystery behind their deadly demise.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E02 — Danger Ahead
The enigmatic shipwrecks of El Faro and the Empress of Ireland occurred a century apart and both remain a mystery of the sea; armed with the latest technology, experts explore these doomed ships to discover what set them on the path to catastrophe.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E06 — Fail Invasions
Countless shipwrecks lost in the depths of the oceans are time capsules containing tales of adventure and tragedy; now, marine experts hunt to locate these forgotten ships, explore their secrets and unlock their incredible stories.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E08 — Collision Course
Three historical collisions expose the volatile risks at sea and how they have shaped the technological advancements of today; now, maritime researchers explore the remnants of these shipwrecks to uncover what happened in their fatal, final moments.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E07 — Lost Fleet of WWI
More than 50 massive warships were lost in a matter of hours in the Scottish natural harbor of Scapa Flow during World War I; now, marine archaeologists use cutting-edge technology to explore one of the greatest acts of defiance in wartime history.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E01 — Nuclear Wrecks
The remains of five warships could reveal new insights into how the nuclear arms race changed the world forever; using 3-D sonar scan technology, an expert team of marine scientists investigate the catastrophic effects of atomic explosions at sea.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E10 — Scotland's Sea Secrets
For over a century, the stories and wrecks of HMS Hampshire and HMS Vanguard continue to be shrouded in mystery; two research teams are granted special access to investigate and uncover what happened to these WWI warships in their final moments.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E09 — Toxic Wrecks
As shipwrecks of World War II continue to erode in the sea, their toxic cargoes continue to pose a catastrophic threat; now, experts use cutting-edge tech to investigate and reveal the potential impact of these noxious underwater dangers.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E01 — Killer Rocks
Earth is hit by 100 tons of rock from space every day; most burn up in the atmosphere, but a single rock wiped out the dinosaurs.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E02 — Death Ray
When a massive star dies, it can direct a blast of radiation that could obliterate all life.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E03 — Cosmic Scrap
More than 100 million pieces of small space debris are floating around the Earth; a collision between two of these objects in low Earth orbit could be catastrophic.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E04 — Little Green Men
Aliens could be lethal killers who want to invade and plunder our world; a team of experts investigates extra-terrestrial beings and their threat to human life.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E05 — Dark Star
Until recently, black holes were only theoretical; scientists know that millions exist and some of them have the potential to be lethal to earth.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E06 — Big Sleep
Experts discuss the many possible ways that could spark the beginning of the end for the universe, including when and why it would happen.

title: Strip the Cosmos
description:
S01 E05 — Alien Worlds
Using CGI to strip apart bizarre planets and strange moons and peel away impenetrable atmospheres to uncover the secrets to extraterrestrial life.

title: Unearthed
description:
S07 E15 — Seven Wonders of the Silk Road
The Silk Road was the ancient trade route that connected Eastern and Western worlds. The road traveled through many countries and was a source of ancient mystery. Even today, the road is shrouded in mystery.

description:
S03 E01 — Pluto Under Pressure
Lost tapes show that Apollo astronauts heard unexplained transmissions on the far side of the moon; an amateur astronomer finds an odd disturbance in Martian atmosphere; an unidentified object in Earth orbit starts stalking Russian spacecraft.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E02 — Return of the Moon Bugs
Apollo 12 astronauts bring back something alive from the moon; NASA tracks an asteroid heading towards Earth but make an incredible discovery.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E04 — Aliens of the Microcosmos
The hidden kingdom of microscopic alien organisms shapes the universe as much as galaxies, stars, and planets; new discoveries reveal how bacteria, viruses and other microorganisms built life on Earth and influence humanity's future in the cosmos.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E11 — Mystery of Alien Worlds
An explosion in the discovery of exoplanets is challenging everything we know about our universe; experts use cutting-edge astronomy to investigate these mysterious alien worlds and how they defy the laws of physics.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E05 — Curse of the White Dwarf
White dwarfs are small, dead stars with a dangerous side, and they are capable of exploding into supernovas and destroying planets; new research suggests these mysterious phenomena may be the key to understanding the universe itself.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E02 — Cincinnati's Secret Caverns
Deep beneath the streets of Cincinnati lies a network of deserted tunnels and caverns that contain a remarkable history of the city's origins, and now, experts investigate to reveal who built this underground labyrinth and why it was abandoned.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E02 — Grand Canyon's Lost Treasure
Descending more than 200 feet beneath the Arizona bedrock lies the largest dry cave system in North America; experts explore this vast subterranean network to reveal the mysteries and undiscovered treasure that remain hidden within its walls.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E03 — Murder Raid Tunnels
Hidden beneath the town of Ramsgate, England, lies a hidden network of over three miles of air raid tunnels; experts investigate and uncover an extensive WWII bomb shelter that became a permanent refuge for many civilians after a devastating attack.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E01 — Hotel Bunker of the Apocalypse
The top-secret construction of a massive nuclear bunker remained concealed under a palatial West Virginia hotel for decades; experts reveal how this vast subterranean structure was one of the most closely guarded Cold War secrets in U.S. history.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E05 — Mystery of the Kentucky Cave
The longest known cave system in the world spans hundreds of miles beneath the hills of Kentucky, and containing prehistoric artifacts and ancient human remains, experts reveal a subterranean mystery that may have changed the course of U.S. history.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Noah's Ark: The Endless Quest
Explorers investigate the snow-covered Ararat Mountains for remains of Noah's Ark; two separate expeditions claim discoveries in different areas, fueling debates over the truth of the story.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
The Ten Plagues: A Greek Curse?
The ten plagues of Egypt are supposedly sent by God to convince Pharaoh to free the Israelites; some scientists link these events to a volcanic eruption or climate change; could these be natural occurrences or are they divine warnings?

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
The Incas: A Sudden Fall
In 1532, Spanish conquistadors encounter the advanced Inca Empire; despite their sophisticated infrastructure, the Inca falls within decades; the story of how a powerful empire is overtaken by a small group of conquistadors remains mysterious.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Ramses II: The Greatest Pharaoh
Rameses II led Egypt through a sixty-year golden age as a powerful pharaoh; despite his recorded achievements, researchers investigate lingering mysteries regarding his wife Nefertari and his death.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
El Dorado: Gold, Guns and Greed
El Dorado, the legendary city of gold, captivated Europeans in the 16th and 17th centuries, sparking endless quests for hidden treasures; fueled by greed, these expeditions led to the loss of countless lives.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Ancient Rome: Fall or Pushed?
The Roman Empire fell in the year 476, yet questions linger; did it truly fall or does it continue as the Byzantine Empire? What caused its demise? The debate remains controversial even among modern historians.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E05 — Mysterious Death of Jeffrey Epstein
Andrew investigates what really happened to Jeffrey Epstein; by reconstructing the crime scene using insider insights, expert analysis and a full replica of his jail cell, he tests whether the evidence points to suicide, murder or something darker.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E02 — Jersey Drone Panic
When a swarm of craft floods New Jersey's skies, panic erupts online; Andrew digs into every conspiracy theory, interviewing eyewitnesses and testing cutting-edge drone tech, until he uncovers the truth behind the incident.

description:
S03 E03 — Rise of the Ice Creatures
Neil Armstrong enters an unexplained spin; an Apollo 17 photo seems to show a US military outpost on the Moon; possible alien life swimming in the oceans of Jupiter's moons.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E04 — Ghosts on a Comet
When a Chinese moon rover breaks down, a scientist at NASA points to a mysterious material that seemed to sabotage the Apollo missions decades earlier; the Rosetta spacecraft discovers a comet that appears to be singing.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E07 — The Next Supernova
The galaxy is full of stars ready to explode into supernovas, a stellar detonation powerful enough to destroy all life on Earth; it's an event that hasn't occurred in 400 years, and the search is on to locate which star may be next.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S11 E05 — Solar System Special
Exploring new discoveries that rewrite the history of the solar system, revealing a complex and violent story that begins with the birth of the sun from the debris of a massive galactic collision to its eventual fate as a lone zombie star.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
S02 E01 — Inside the Terror Factory
Guided missiles, the Wasserfall, and the potentially war-changing V2 were dreamed up and tested in a base in Peenemünde.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
S02 E02 — Secret Nazi City
As the Nazis embark on their dominate rise to power, a massive construction project secretly begins across Eastern Germany; using the latest tech, experts uncover an elaborate network of underground tunnels and bunkers with frightening ambitions.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
Secrets of the Owl Mountains
Experts uncover a mysteriously abandoned underground complex that may have hid something very dark.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
S02 E03 — Underground Superweapons
A labyrinth of tunnels carved deep in the Polish mountains leads to the largest underground Nazi weapons development complex ever discovered.
